attempts.summary: Configured node1 (OPNsense) to route between two new interfaces (LANA=vtnet1/10.50.10.1 facing node2, LANB=vtnet2/10.50.20.1 facing node3), added firewall pass rules for both, and added a single hybrid-mode outbound SNAT rule (source 10.50.10.0/24, interface opt2/LANB) that translates node2->node3 traffic to node1's LANB address (10.50.20.1) while leaving node3->node2 traffic un-NATed. Verified with real TCP connections in both directions, then completed the mandatory one-at-a-time restart/recovery protocol on all three nodes, confirming changed boot identities and full functional recovery of the asymmetric NAT behavior afterward.
